title: The Botanical Evacuation
premise: An office of seed collectors is packing a living archive before the harbor is overrun.
opening: A radio call cuts through the harbor fog. Carry the names home.

stories.title: THE LAST TIDE
lines: Inez logged the water at midnight.
The archive must reach the roof.

stories.title: RADIO CHECK
lines: Cal heard a reply beyond the harbor.
Keep the aerial clear.

stories.title: SALVAGE ROSTER
lines: Rumi counted every person twice.
No one leaves the names behind.

stories.title: SHIFT NOTES
lines: Esme: move dry records upstairs.
Nico: the eastern windows are cracked.

stories.title: BEFORE THE STORM
lines: Tamsin and Paz at the summer regatta.

stories.title: A FOLDED NOTE
lines: Ellis, the blue folder is yours.
Luz kept your place by the radio.

rooms.title: Seed catalog
rooms.description: Inez left this botanical workspace ready for the evacuation.

props.label: Inez
props.text: Inez left this tea cooling when the alarm sounded.

props.label: BOOK
props.text: Inez's botanical field notes. Keep this volume dry.

props.label: PAPERS
props.text: Inventory signed by Inez. Cal took the last crate.

rooms.title: Germination room
rooms.description: Cal left this botanical workspace ready for the evacuation.

props.label: PEN
props.text: Cal marked each rescued record with this pen.

props.label: PHOTO
props.text: Cal and Rumi before the evacuation.

props.label: NOTE
props.text: Rumi, meet Cal upstairs. Bring the botanical ledger.

rooms.title: Field records
rooms.description: Rumi left this botanical workspace ready for the evacuation.

props.label: SEEDLING
props.text: Rumi's cutting. Shelter it from the broken window.

props.label: BOTTLE
props.text: Drinking water reserved for Rumi's return.

props.label: PHONE
props.text: Last call from Rumi: the roof signal is still working.

props.label: TROPHY
props.text: Awarded to Dev for the community survey.
